description: Specify the update interval. The porosity, particle-applied force, and drag force are updated every i cycles. These quantities are also calculated before and after the exchange of coupling information with CFD. A value of zero can be given to specify no updates during cycling. By default, i = 1.

examples.description: Update porosity and drag every 2 cycles

verification: Live-verified 2026-11-09 on PFC3D 6.00, 7.00 and 9.8 consoles (syntax grade): accepted on all three consoles.
